instructions: Complete the summary below. Choose ONE WORD ONLY from the passage for each answer.
stem_block:
What was thrown out, and why

Looked at item by item, rice was easily the heaviest single loss, followed by smaller but still notable amounts of carrots, (37) ........ , tofu and tempeh. Asked to account for what they had thrown out, families in the two districts said much the same things: mould and spoilage lay behind most of the rice, vegetables and bread that was lost, while a change in (38) ........ explained much of the waste of meat, fish and eggs. Country households still wasted far less, since leftovers there were more often turned into compost or given to animals; town households leaned instead towards (39) ........ and bought more than they required. For the authors, the answer is not to treat food waste as one undifferentiated problem: they call for city campaigns aimed at rice, vegetables and (40) ........ , together with help for households in keeping perishable goods edible for longer.

items.prompt: Rice was easily the heaviest single loss, followed by smaller but still notable amounts of carrots, (37) ........ , tofu and tempeh.
items.evidence: Individual items told a similar story: households discarded an average of 14.2 kilograms of rice a year, alongside smaller but still notable amounts of carrots, cabbage, tofu and tempeh.
items.explanation: Paragraph E lists the individual foods discarded: rice by far the heaviest, together with smaller amounts of carrots, cabbage, tofu and tempeh; so the answer is 'cabbage'.

yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: The biggest inedible category by some way was (37) ........ from fruit and vegetables, above all from bananas and mangoes.
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: Among inedible waste, fruit and vegetable peelings, dominated by banana and mango skins, made up the largest category by far.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Esdizim kilidi: 'meyve ve sebzeden gelen, ozellikle muz ve mangodan' cercevesi tek bir adayla doluyor; kok metinsiz okundugunda da peelings/peel/skins ciktisi geliyordu. Ayrica basliklar listesindeki vii ('Skins and other leftovers...') cevabin es anlamlisini ayni testin baska bir paketinde acikca yaziyordu.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Bosluk ayni paragrafin bir onceki cumlesine (E/2), tek tek tartilan yiyeceklerin dokumune tasindi. Cevap artik bir kategori adi degil, listede gecen belirli bir sebze; hangi sebzenin sayildigi yalniz metinden okunur. Kabuk cumlesi (E/3) bu paketten cikti ve basliklar listesindeki vii ile arasindaki es anlamli cakismasi da kapandi.

items.prompt: Mould and spoilage lay behind most of the rice, vegetables and bread that was lost, while a change in (38) ........ explained much of the waste of meat, fish and eggs.
items.evidence: Spoilage and mould accounted for most losses of rice, vegetables, bread and packaged goods; changes in texture explained much of the waste among meat, fish, eggs, tofu and tempeh; and short shelf life was blamed for bread in particular.
items.explanation: Paragraph G says that changes in texture explained much of the waste among meat, fish, eggs, tofu and tempeh; so the answer is 'texture'.

yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: Dairy items, meanwhile, were regularly overlooked at the back of the (38) ........ and only thrown out once it was too late.
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: Dairy products were frequently forgotten at the back of the refrigerator until they had to be discarded.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Esdizim kilidi: 'sut urunleri ___ arkasinda unutuluyor' kalibinin tek adayi var; ustelik parcasiz olcumde uc turda da 'fridge' geldi ve dar kabul listesi bunu reddediyordu, yani kalem hem sizdiriyor hem haksiz puan kaybettiriyordu.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Bosluk ayni paragrafin 2. cumlesine tasindi ve hedefi bir nesne olmaktan cikip israfin nedeni oldu. 'Etin, baligin ve yumurtanin neyi degisince atildigi' sorusunun ilk akla gelen yanitlari koku ve renktir; metin dokuyu seciyor, yani cevap ancak G/2 okunarak bulunuyor. Sut urunleri cumlesi (G/4) bu paketten cikti.

items.prompt: Town households leaned instead towards (39) ........ and bought more than they required.
items.evidence: Urban residents, by contrast, tended to favour convenience and were more prone to buying more than they needed, a pattern the researchers connect to busier schedules and greater purchasing power rather than carelessness.
items.explanation: Paragraph H says that city dwellers favoured convenience and were more likely to buy more than they needed; so the answer is 'convenience'.

items.prompt: They call for city campaigns aimed at rice, vegetables and (40) ........ , together with help for households in keeping perishable goods edible for longer.
items.evidence: They recommend urban campaigns aimed specifically at rice, vegetables and legumes, alongside wider efforts to help households extend the shelf life of perishable goods.
items.explanation: Paragraph I says the authors recommend urban campaigns aimed specifically at rice, vegetables and legumes; so the answer is 'legumes'.

yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: For the authors, the lesson is that policy has so far dealt with collecting and disposing of waste; real (40) ........ , they argue, will depend on campaigns that name the particular foods concerned.
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: The authors argue that food waste policy in Indonesia, as in many countries, has focused on collection and disposal rather than prevention, and that meaningful reductions will depend on tackling the specific items and behaviours identified in the study, rather than treating food waste as a single undifferentiated problem.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Esdizim kilidi ve cift aday: kanit cumlesi hem 'prevention' hem 'reductions' tasiyor, ozet cumlesi ise pasajin 'reductions will depend on' obegini nerdeyse birebir yankiladigi icin 'reductions' en az anahtar kadar savunulabiliyordu. Ayrica atik politikasi soyleminde 'toplama ve bertaraf' karsitliginin oteki ucu her zaman 'prevention'dir.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Bosluk ayni paragrafin 2. cumlesine, yazarlarin somut kampanya onerisine tasindi. Cevap artik bir politika terimi degil, onerinin adini verdigi ucuncu yiyecek grubu; tek adayi var ve yalniz I/2'den okunuyor. Politika karsitligi cumlesi (I/1) bu paketten cikti.
